title: Judge puts temporary pause on Paramount-Warner merger
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. Reports are focusing on this development: Judge puts temporary pause on Paramount-Warner merger. In simple words, Paramount Skydance’s takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery hit a roadblock Monday after a federal judge temporarily paused the proposed merger Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
